name: Performance section compares bot speeds with progress bars
description: The 'Adu Mekanik Kecepatan' panel must show three stacked comparison rows (BobaSticker 0.8s, Bot Lain 3.5s, Bot Jadul 5.0s+) each with a horizontal progress bar, where the BobaSticker bar is the shortest.

planSteps.description: Scroll to the section 'Bukan Sekadar Janji Manis Kayak Mantan'

The speed panel titled 'Adu Mekanik Kecepatan (Detik)' shows three comparison rows stacked vertically: 'BobaSticker' with value '0.8s', 'Bot Lain (Yang Bikin Emosi)' with '3.5s', and 'Bot Jadul (Sering Ngantri)' with '5.0s+' — each row has a horizontal progress bar, and the BobaSticker bar is visibly the shortest
